author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Clap's rapid major version releases (2.x to 3.x to 4.x) created migration burden. Also: large dependency tree, desire for more control over argument semantics.

Sources:
- 082245d: 'The first time I had the thought of moving off of Clap was during the 2->3->4 transition. I thought the 3.x and 4.x releases were great, but for me, it ended up moving a little too quickly... I didn't want to run on the migration treadmill.'
title: Clap 2→3→4 migration treadmill concerns
